errors.text: The proposed Si addition and silicide phase are unsupported for this alloy system; no evidence establishes that 1–3 at.% Si will form a beneficial reticulated network rather than embrittling grain-boundary precipitates.
The density trade-off is likely misstated: adding low-atomic-mass Si substitutionally would generally be expected to reduce, not marginally increase, alloy density.

The experiment does not cleanly separate solid-solution hardening from the phase-network mechanism because it lacks a single-phase Si-containing control or a composition/heat-treatment series that independently varies solute content and intermetallic morphology.
